answer: In PoA, each identity escrows bonded collateral, but correlated equivocation links identities through shared timing, messages, or funding. Once k identities are proven to coordinate, their slashing obligation scales as O(k^2), increasing marginal exposure with swarm size. Detection additionally applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the sybil cluster, rapidly exhausting stake; signal, delta, and inlet metrics may reinforce correlation evidence without replacing proof.
